subject: Coordinating multi-region SE deep-dive — overlapping windows & DST impact
messages:
From: Alexandre Dubois <alexandre.dubois@acme-cloud.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com
Cc: priya.sharma@acme-cloud.com, eng-team@acme-cloud.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: Request: Technical deep dive — multi-region deployment & network constraints

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re ready to do the technical deep-dive on our multi-region deployment and network constraints. The core ask is a 90-minute session with one of your solutions engineers and our platform/infra architects to review: routing/failover, KV cache behavior under cross-region latency, and recommended batching/quantization settings for our mix of high-throughput ingestion and interactive flows.

Attendees (approx):
- Alexandre Dubois (Platform lead, Acme Cloud — Paris)
- Priya Sharma (Infra architect, Acme Cloud — London)
- eng-team@acme-cloud.com (group alias: APAC infra leads — mostly Sydney & Singapore timezones)

Constraints:
- Prefer a single session if we can get a 90-min overlap, otherwise two focused 60-min sessions (NA/EU and EU/APAC) are ok.
- Important: US DST starts on 2026-03-08. If we book based on local wall times we’ll risk confusion for our SF folks who will shift an hour the week after next.

Attached: acme_availability_v2.xlsx (their rough availability matrix). Can you propose specific UTC-aligned windows so we can pin invites unambiguously?

Thanks — we’re trying to lock this in for the week of Mar 9 if possible.

—Alexandre
Alexandre Dubois
Platform Lead, Acme Cloud
acme-cloud.com

From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Alexandre Dubois <alexandre.dubois@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 00:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep dive — multi-region deployment & network constraints

Alexandre — thanks for the details and the availability sheet. Attaching a short plan below and a proposed approach to avoid DST confusion: pin everything in UTC on the invites (we’ll include local times in the description).

Proposal (two options):
1) Single 90-min window (hard to find a friendly hour for APAC folks):
   - Wed Mar 11, 15:30–17:00 UTC — this hits: 07:30 PT (SF), 16:30 CET (Paris/London), 02:30 AEDT (Sydney next day).
   - Good sample coverage but APAC will be late.

2) Two focused 60-min sessions (preferred for participant comfort):
   - NA/EU sync: Wed Mar 11, 14:30–15:30 UTC — 06:30 PT, 15:30 CET (covers SF + EU architects)
   - EU/APAC sync: Thu Mar 12, 08:00–09:00 UTC — 09:00 CET, 19:00 AEDT (covers EU daytime + APAC evening)

Notes:
- Because US DST starts Mar 8, those local US times will shift if invites are scheduled using "local time" after Mar 8; that’s why I prefer we lock to UTC in the calendar metadata.
- I’m looping in Logan (SE) and Jordan (AM/Account lead) to confirm SE coverage and to propose which topics to split between sessions if we go two-session.

If three of you can confirm preferred option and rough attendee list for each session, I’ll send formal calendar invites with Meet links and attach a one-page agenda.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, Alexandre Dubois <alexandre.dubois@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 01:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep dive — multi-region deployment & network constraints

Quick note — Acme is high priority here (HubSpot: ACME-98765). If we can split into two sessions I prefer NA/EU first to lock the north-south failover discussion, then EU/APAC for the cross-continental recovery scenarios.

Rachel — please confirm SE time commitment (we should have 2 SEs available in case we need breakout on networking + model serving).

—Jordan (on behalf of GTM)
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: logan_wright@redwood.com
To: rachel_kim@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: Alexandre Dubois <alexandre.dubois@acme-cloud.com>, priya.sharma@acme-cloud.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Technical deep dive — multi-region deployment & network constraints

On Thu, Mar 5, 2026 at 10:15 AM Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposal (two options):
> ...

Thanks for the ping — Logan here, Solutions Engineer. I can cover model-serving behavior, batching and quantization trade-offs. Dylan can lead the networking/failover breakout if needed. I agree with splitting into two 60-min sessions to reduce overnight burden.

Suggested concrete UTC slots (I’ll hold these tentatively):
- NA/EU: Wed Mar 11, 14:30–15:30 UTC (I’ll set NA-EU_deep-dive.ics)
- EU/APAC: Thu Mar 12, 08:00–09:00 UTC (I’ll set EU-APAC_deep-dive.ics)

Attached for the team: network_topology_v1.pdf (Acme’s brief we received) — please confirm the list of people who must attend each session and any pre-reads you want us to prepare.

I’ll create Meet links and include UTC + local time conversions in the invite body (explicitly call out the DST date for US attendees).

—Logan Wright
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.com
From: Alexandre Dubois <alexandre.dubois@acme-cloud.com>

On Thu, Mar 5, 2026 at 10:15 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’ll create Meet links and include UTC + local time conversions in the invite body (explicitly call out the DST date for US attendees).

Thanks Logan and team — two-session approach works best for us. Confirmed attendees per session: 
- NA/EU (Wed Mar 11, 14:30–15:30 UTC): Alexandre Dubois, Priya Sharma, SF infra lead (remote), Redwood: Rachel, Logan.
- EU/APAC (Thu Mar 12, 08:00–09:00 UTC): Priya Sharma, APAC infra leads (Sydney & Singapore), Redwood: Logan (primary), Dylan (network breakout).

We’ll review the network_topology_v1.pdf beforehand. Please send Meet links and ICS files pinned in UTC — Priya noted she’ll forward the invites to the full APAC roster once she has the UTC times.

—Alexandre
From: rachel_kim@redwood.com
To: Alexandre Dubois <alexandre.dubois@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: logan_wright@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 18:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: NA/EU + EU/APAC deep-dive (UTC pinned invites + pre-reads)

Alexandre & team — confirmed. Calendar invites and Meet links below (all invites pinned to UTC in metadata and description includes local conversions + DST note). Attachments are included in the invites.

Invites sent:
- NA/EU Deep-dive — Wed Mar 11, 14:30–15:30 UTC — Meet: https://meet.google.com/rdw-na-eu-123 — Invite: NA-EU_deep-dive.ics
- EU/APAC Deep-dive — Thu Mar 12, 08:00–09:00 UTC — Meet: https://meet.google.com/rdw-eu-apac-456 — Invite: EU-APAC_deep-dive.ics

Pre-reads attached: network_topology_v1.pdf, and we took your availability spreadsheet into account (acme_availability_v2.xlsx). Logan will lead model-serving and batching items; Dylan will lead the networking breakouts.

Action items:
- Priya / Alexandre: forward invites to the full APAC roster (we kept the EU/APAC session at 08:00 UTC to keep it after business hours in APAC rather than overnight).
- Redwood (Logan + Dylan): prepare a 1-pager on recommended batching/quantization defaults and an annotated diagram for the cross-region KV-cache flow (we’ll drop in the shared Drive link before the sessions).
- Rachel/Jordan: follow up post-sessions with a mutual action plan and next steps in HubSpot (ACME-98765).

If anything changes please reply-all and we’ll adjust. Looking forward — appreciate the flexibility on timing.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
